text: Carpentry is the craft of constructing and building structures using wood. The foundation of any carpentry project begins with sawing, the precise cutting of wood into the required dimensions. Wood is sawed on a sawing machine to create flat surfaces for joining other pieces together. Once the pieces are cut, sanding is applied to smooth the surfaces and remove imperfections. After sanding, the pieces are then joined together using various woodworking techniques, further completing the carpentry project.
